company.name: Yellow Door Energy
company.shortDescription: Yellow Door Energy develops solar projects to deliver energy solutions for commercial and industrial clients.
company.description: Yellow Door Energy is a sustainable solar energy company focusing on solar energy solutions for commercial and industrial customers across the Middle East and Africa. Yellow Door Energy manages all stages of the solar plant, and once the solar plant starts producing electricity, you pay a monthly solar bill. Yellow Door Energy aims to develop over 1GW of distributed solar and energy solutions, emphasizing their commitment to sustainability and renewable energy in the region.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $27,225,753, or 5.53% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $376,872,589 to $969,543,736, a 2.57x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 72 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 29 (-20).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
